note: This file freezes the M0/M1 protocol and PREREGISTERS M2 before any M1 result exists. It must not be modified after M1 results are seen. M1 numbers are reported against this file; its sha256 is recorded in the M1 metadata.

empirical_basis: semantic reliability increment under random composition ~ 0 (delta_semantic_random approx 0)
semantic reliability increment under same-category competition > 0 (delta_semantic_hard > 0)
replicated across B0 (V1 B/32, frozen), B1 (OpenCLIP B/16), B2 (SigLIP B/16)

objective.target: P(c_hat = c* | q, C, frozen grounding decision)
objective.meaning: estimate the probability that the candidate currently selected by the FROZEN grounding scorer is correct
explicitly_out_of_scope: modifying grounding prediction / candidate scores / candidate ranking / top-1 candidate
solving candidate-set shift in the grounding scorer

hypothesis_frozen.text_en: Reliability correction should focus on the local competition geometry around the current winner rather than modeling the full candidate set indiscriminately.
hypothesis_frozen.text_zh: 真正需要额外修正的不是所有候选，而是当前赢家附近那些'分数高、语义相似、足以构成威胁'的竞争者。
hypothesis_frozen.evidence_backing: V2-G: delta_semantic_random approx 0 vs delta_semantic_hard > 0, 3/3 backbones

grounding_scorer_frozen.failure_condition: if LCR changes grounding accuracy -> IMPLEMENTATION FAILURE -> STOP

local_competition_set.definition: the M competitors outside the winner with the highest B3 scores
local_competition_set.reason: K >= 5 in all primary regimes, so no padding is needed; M is frozen
local_competition_set.ordering: stable descending B3 order (ties broken by lower candidate index, numpy stable argsort)

relation_vector.definition: r_j = [ds_norm, dp, a_t, a_j, a_t - a_j, v_tj, rank_j_over_k]

terms.ds_norm: (s_t - s_j) / (std(s) + eps), std over all K B3 scores (ddof=0), eps = 1e-8
terms.dp: p_t - p_j with p = softmax(s / T_corrected) using the scorer's own frozen corrected global temperature
terms.a_t - a_j: explicit gap of the two query cosines
terms.rank_j_over_k: 1-based descending B3 rank of competitor j over K (winner = 1; competitors carry ranks 2..M+1)

forbidden_additions: any new meta information beyond candidate count

ambiguity_gate.gate_input: a = [max_j v_tj, mean_j v_tj, ds_norm(j=B3 rank 2)]

base_reliability_branch_frozen.R1: Stats Logistic (17 score statistics), fitted under the M1 protocol on random-only training rows
base_reliability_branch_frozen.b: logit(R1) = coef . x_std + intercept (exact linear logit, no clipping needed)
base_reliability_branch_frozen.rule: R1 is frozen while training LCR; retraining R1 to accommodate LCR is forbidden
base_reliability_branch_frozen.purpose: isolate what local competition information adds beyond score statistics

capacity_control.name: Aggregate-MLP
capacity_control.input: V2-G frozen 31d = 17 score stats + 14 V2 primary semantic stats
capacity_control.training_protocol: identical to LCR (same data, same optimizer philosophy, same LR grid, same seeds)

LCR-noGate.question: does the ambiguity-gating structure itself carry the improvement?

naming_note_E1b.declaration: In this V2-M stage, 'E1b' denotes the semantic-augmented logistic baseline = 17 score stats + 14 V2 primary semantic stats (31d) logistic regression, trained with the M1 protocol on the same random-only rows as LCR.
naming_note_E1b.rationale: V2-G used this same 'R2' object as the frozen reference for the hard-competition semantic increment; the V1-frozen 33d e1b bundle is a different (V1) object and is NOT part of M1 primary comparisons.
naming_note_E1b.reporting: M1 reports LCR vs E1b (primary) and LCR vs R1 (secondary)

data_regimes.category_labels_policy: category labels are used only for controlled candidate construction, never as reliability-model input

training_data_M1.name: M1 - Zero-Hard-Exposure
training_data_M1.rows: val_calib reliability_train images (image-level split, seed 20260928, train_frac 0.70)
training_data_M1.tuning_rows: val_calib reliability_tune images, Random K5 + K10 only

test_cohorts_frozen.Random-K5: frozen B3 raw_scores K=5 rows with eval_split in (testA, testB)
test_cohorts_frozen.SameCategory-K5: frozen V1 hard cohort cell hard5 (same4 mask, results/phase1f_hard_semantic), n=9487 rows / 1424 images
test_cohorts_frozen.K20 random: frozen B3 raw_scores K=20 rows with eval_split in (testA, testB)
test_cohorts_frozen.K50 random: frozen B3 raw_scores K=50 rows with eval_split in (testA, testB)

training_protocol.seeds_note: the 3 seeds are training replicates of the same protocol; they are NOT concatenated into independent samples
training_protocol.early_stopping: monitor tune-block NLL (reliability_tune Random K5/K10 only), restore best state; hard performance must never select a checkpoint
training_protocol.lr_selection: mean AUROC_correct over reliability_tune Random K5/K10; tie rule: prefer smaller LR when within 0.002 (house A7 rule)
training_protocol.logistic_selection: C grid (0.1, 1.0, 10.0) selected by the same tune mean AUROC with the same tie rule
training_protocol.standardization: logistic branches (R1/E1b) use train-only standardisation fitted on the combined K5+K10 train rows (house protocol); LCR/noGate/Aggregate-MLP consume their frozen raw feature definitions without additional standardisation

statistics.shared_draws: all comparisons on the same cohort share the same bootstrap draws (one cluster resample per replicate reused by every model and pair)
reporting: per-seed point estimates and paired CIs
per-seed direction (n seeds with positive delta)
aggregation convention for gates: seed-mean of per-seed point deltas; seed-mean of per-seed CI bounds (V2-G house convention)

definitions.e_aurc: ccg.experiment.phase0b._e_aurc_metric (AURC - oracle AURC at the block accuracy)

structure_contribution_gate.requirement: SameCategory-K5: AUROC(LCR) - AUROC(Aggregate-MLP) > 0 AND paired bootstrap CI_low > 0

gate_contribution.rule: if LCR significantly better -> ambiguity gating supported; if effectively equal -> keep results but the gate must not be written as the main contribution
gate_contribution.forbidden: re-designing the gate because the gate comparison failed

k_generalization.requirement: no systematic degradation of LCR vs E1b (observe AUROC, E-AURC, RER50)
k_generalization.operational_definition: systematic degradation flagged when a metric shows seed-mean delta strictly worse AND seed-mean CI bound excluding 0 on the worse side; additionally report material-degradation flags at (AUROC < -0.005) / (E-AURC reduction < -5%) / (RER50 gain < -3pp)

grounding_invariance_check.requirement: every evaluation verifies accuracy_before == accuracy_after and row-wise grounding decision bit-identical / index-identical; LCR only changes the reliability score
grounding_invariance_check.implementation: sha256 fingerprints of the frozen score matrix and of the argmax index vector are taken before and after every evaluation stage; any change raises (IMPLEMENTATION FAILURE)

m0_tests_required_before_M1: no hard data in M1 train/tune

method_freeze_point.rule: after M1 + M2 complete on B0, the following are FROZEN and must not be modified based on B1/B2: relation vector, M, hidden dimensions, gate, loss, optimizer, LR selection rule, training regimes, model-selection metric

V2-MG.precondition: B0's LCR must reach at least M1 GO or M2 GO
V2-MG.procedure: B1/B2 use the exact same architecture/hyperparameters; per-backbone weight retraining allowed; structural changes forbidden
V2-MG.supported_rule: at least one of B1/B2 significantly positive and the other not significantly negative -> METHOD CROSS-BACKBONE SUPPORTED
V2-MG.strong_rule: 2/2 significantly positive -> STRONG METHOD CROSS-BACKBONE GENERALITY

M2_preregistration.rule: run only after M1 completes; the M2 definition below must not be modified regardless of M1 success or failure; M2 baselines must be refit under the identical curriculum

training.meaning: number of same-category competitors injected by the frozen same_category manifest level construction

M2_preregistration.purpose: under an explicit competition curriculum, can LCR extrapolate to competition severity stronger than training?

baselines_fairness.rule: ALL models are retrained on the same m=0/2/4 data; LCR must never see hard curriculum while a baseline only sees random

gate.support_statement: structured competition modeling generalizes beyond training severity

core_figure_plan.control: Aggregate-MLP drawn alongside as capacity control
core_figure_plan.status: M1 produces the Random-K5 / SameCategory-K5 / K20 / K50 analogue; the full m-axis figure belongs to M2

interpretation_boundary.allowed_if_success: A lightweight local-competition reliability module improves correctness estimation under candidate competition.

forbidden: any protocol change after seeing M1 results
